reading_guide.Question: Target or phenotype
reading_guide.First files to open: Data S1 fixed_estimates, panel_specific and fixed_decisions. Tables S66–S73 give the primary groups.

reading_guide.Question: Coverage and reference choice
reading_guide.First files to open: Data S1 family_summary, candidate_coverage and ordered_specifications. Tables S17, S20, S26–S28 and S83 cover membership and missing-data sensitivity.

reading_guide.Question: Background and inference
reading_guide.First files to open: Data S1 background_summary, background_proteins, genotype_estimates and equivalence. Tables S52–S59 provide harmonized comparisons.

reading_guide.Question: Simulation and calibration
reading_guide.First files to open: Tables S30 and S80–S82. Per-draw benchmark scores and design-map checks appear in Data S2.

reading_guide.Question: Inputs of the revised figures
reading_guide.First files to open: Data S2 includes the linked CAA and regional-enzyme scores, reference geometry, synthetic field and pump accession map.
